name: fw-setup
description: Freshworks FDK + nvm. Commands: install (--version), upgrade (--to), downgrade, uninstall, status (--verbose), troubleshoot (--fix), use (workspace .nvmrc). Legacy /fdk-install, etc.

interface.shortDescription: Install and manage FDK with Node.js via nvm.
interface.longDescription: Shell Tasks and inline commands for FDK 10 on Node 24 (publishing), optional FDK 9 on Node 18, uninstall, status, troubleshoot --fix, and workspace nvm/.nvmrc. Legacy /fdk-* slash aliases where registered.

commands.name: fw-setup-upgrade
commands.description: Upgrade FDK; use --to X.Y.Z for pinned semver

commands.name: fw-setup-downgrade
commands.description: Downgrade to FDK 9 + Node 18; optional 9.x.y pin

commands.name: fw-setup-use
commands.description: Workspace: nvm use / .nvmrc for FDK 10 vs 9 stack; inline
